desc: Experience agility and maneuverability with the 8 Inch 5.56 AR15 CQB from Andro Corp Industries. Designed for shooters who value compact performance, this American-made AR pistol features an 8-inch barrel, SBA3 pistol brace and precision components for reliable operation in close-quarters scenarios. Perfect for tactical use, home defense, or range training, the 5.56 AR15 CQB delivers the quality and craftsmanship you expect from Andro Corp.
